bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/ (path, raster, surface, context, face, color, image, paint, reusable_layer, pdf, pdf/context), springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (Surface, Image), springboard/sdk/src/graphics_context.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_stroke.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_gradient.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_color.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pattern.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_layer.rs, springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (kit::cg re-export), springboard/ui/src/print.rs
summary: The render crate's cg tree is public to apps as bifrost_app::kit::cg, and the SDK adds graphics_context, graphics_stroke, graphics_gradient, graphics_color, graphics_imageio and graphics_pdf wrappers. Paths, stroking, lines, ellipses and arcs, clipping, transforms, colour ramps, shadings, patterns, CgImage, PNG and JPEG decode and encode, and PDF read and write exist as models. Apps reach only part of it (freeform gradients, Preview PDF read, draw and write); a PDF page context (cg::pdf::context::PdfContext) writes the context's drawing as PDF vector pages, CgFont is the size-less face object, Function has a callback form and WebP is written lossless; display and window services still need a live check.

features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Path construction covers move, line, quadratic and cubic curves, arcs, rectangles and ellipses, with bounds, contains and transforms. Stroking supports caps, joins, miter limit and dashes. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by springboard/render/src/cg/path.rs, springboard/render/src/cg/raster.rs; tests cg::path::tests, cg::raster::tests. Built 2026-10-19 (w15-core-graphics): Boolean path operations in springboard/render/src/cg/boolean.rs as methods on Path: union, intersection, subtracting, symmetric_difference, line_intersection, line_subtracting and normalized, each with a fill rule. Curves are flattened, edges are cut at every crossing on a 1/1024 integer grid, the pieces whose two sides differ under the operation are kept and linked into closed loops (interior always on the left, so non-zero and even-odd fills agree); coincident edges and shared seams merge. Results are polygons (no curves). Midget check: run the render crate tests cg::boolean::tests (overlapping_squares_union_to_one_outline, subtracting_cuts_a_notch_and_a_hole, circles_combine_through_flattened_curves, lines_clip_to_a_region) on Midget.

features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Colour spaces and colours are modelled, with ICC profile loading and conversion through the SDK wrapper. The packed 8-bit pixels of the Surface remain sRGB; wide-gamut output is not drawn. Built 2026-10-19 (w15-core-graphics): ColorConversionInfo with the Perceptual intent now compresses an out-of-gamut colour in an RGB destination (ColorSpace::from_xyz_gamut_mapped) by moving it in linear light toward the grey of equal luminance until every channel fits, so hue and lightness stay and only saturation is given up; every other intent still clips each channel, extended-range spaces keep out-of-range values, and Saturation is still the same as relative colorimetric because matrix spaces carry no saturation table. Gap: no shell or app draws through a CgLayer yet; verify on Midget. Refreshed 2026-10-17: covered by springboard/render/src/cg/reusable_layer.rs; tests cg::reusable_layer::tests.

gaps: The PDF page context writes only the twelve standard Latin faces (no embedded TrueType or OpenType faces), no encryption, PDF/A, output intents or tagged structure tree, and the print pipeline still uses PdfWriter.
Most of the cg tree is not used by apps yet: the graphics_* SDK wrappers, shadings, patterns, Boolean path operations and CgImage have no app caller.
Boolean path operations return polygons (curves are flattened), not curves.
Wide-gamut and ICC output: the Surface stays 8-bit sRGB; no HDR, CMYK or 16-bit drawing.
Display and window services: the mode switch and live reconfiguration are not verified on the lab machine, and a live window list from the shell has not been checked on Midget.
Event services: no event tap or synthetic event API for apps (not changed in this refresh).
WebP is written lossless and still only (image-io writer); no lossy or animated WebP writing.
CgFont: no stem width, PostScript subsets or encodings, and the context does not apply a face's variations when drawing.
